name: Washington Health (Fremont) High School Volunteer Program
what_you_do: You can apply to volunteer in hospital roles at Washington Hospital in Fremont. You are a high school student. Openings depend on what the hospital needs.
who_can_apply: Age 16 or older. Seniors are told not to apply because onboarding is long (a college program exists).
deadline_text: The high school waiting list closed May 22, 2026. The page says the next high school round is planned for Fall 2026, with the information session date tentative. Students are contacted only when an info session is scheduled. Call 510-818-7465 to confirm.
how_to_apply: Email volunteer_services@washingtonhealth.com with your name, grade, school, phone and email. They contact you only when an info session is scheduled. Phone 510-818-7465.
notes: No GPA rule or fee appears on the current page (older versions listed a GPA rule and $20 fee). Openings are limited. Office: 2500 Mowry Ave, Fremont. The page says the list is closed as of May 22, 2026, but also says you are welcome to join the list now; call to confirm.
